title: Hill Stations Near Delhi: Weekend and Short-Trip Options
seoTitle: Hill Stations Near Delhi: Weekend and Short-Trip Options | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: Hill stations near Delhi for weekends and short trips: Kasauli, Shimla, Mussoorie, Lansdowne, Nainital, Dhanaulti, Chail and McLeod Ganj, with trains and tips.
description: A guide to the hill stations within reach of Delhi for weekends and short breaks: Lansdowne, Kasauli, Mussoorie, Nainital, Shimla, Dhanaulti, Chail, Morni Hills, Mukteshwar and, overnight, McLeod Ganj and Manali, with approximate distances, the best trains and buses, and how to avoid the traffic.
dek: Delhi has more hill stations within a day's reach than any other big Indian city. Here is how to choose one for a weekend, and how to get there without spending it in traffic.
secondaryKeywords: hill stations within 300 km of Delhi
intro: From Delhi, the nearest hill stations lie in the Shivalik and lower Himalayan ranges of Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh, roughly 250 to 350 km away. With an early start or a morning train, a weekend in the hills is very manageable.
The key is avoiding the worst traffic: leave before dawn or take the Shatabdi or Vande Bharat trains to Kalka, Dehradun or Kathgodam and drive the last stretch.
quickAnswer: The best hill stations near Delhi for a weekend are Lansdowne (about 260 km), Kasauli (about 290 km), Mussoorie (about 290 km), Nainital (about 300 km), Shimla (about 350 km), Dhanaulti and Chail, with Morni Hills for a day trip. McLeod Ganj and Manali work as overnight-bus trips over a long weekend. Take morning trains to Kotdwar, Kalka, Dehradun or Kathgodam to beat the traffic.
takeaways: Lansdowne, Kasauli and Mussoorie are the easiest weekend trips.
Morning trains to Kalka, Dehradun and Kathgodam save hours of highway traffic.
Shimla and Nainital are best with three days rather than two.
McLeod Ganj and Manali suit overnight buses and long weekends.
Avoid Friday evening departures and Sunday evening returns if you can.

body: Overnight buses from Delhi reach both by morning; allow at least two nights there.

sections.heading: Trains that help
list: Kalka Shatabdi to Kalka, for Kasauli, Chail and Shimla (with the toy train onward).
Shatabdi or Vande Bharat trains to Dehradun, for Mussoorie and Dhanaulti.
Shatabdi to Kathgodam, for Nainital, Bhimtal and Mukteshwar.
Book early; weekend seats sell out.

sections.heading: When to go
list: March to June: the classic season; busy weekends.
July to September: landslide risk; choose short, well-travelled routes.
October to December: clear views and calm towns.
January to February: cold; snow is possible in Mussoorie, Dhanaulti, Nainital, Chail and Shimla's higher surroundings.

rows: Train to Kathgodam, Dehradun, Kalka or Kotdwar, or leave Delhi by 5 am
Arrive by lunch; an easy walk and a sunset viewpoint
A longer walk or a nearby excursion (Bhimtal, Landour, Kufri, Tip-n-Top)
Head down by early afternoon to catch a train or beat the evening traffic

sections.heading: Where to stay
paras: On a short trip, stay close to the main walking area so you can make the most of the time: near the Mall in Mussoorie or Nainital, the Ridge in Shimla, or the cantonment in Lansdowne and Kasauli. If you want quiet, Landour, Bhimtal, Mashobra and Chail are good alternatives a short drive from the busiest streets.

safety: Drive times are approximate and depend on traffic, weather and road works; weekend traffic on hill roads can double them. Avoid driving on mountain roads after dark.
Check weather and road updates before leaving, especially in the monsoon.
Book stays early for long weekends.

faqs.q: Which is the nearest hill station to Delhi?
faqs.a: Morni Hills in Haryana and Lansdowne in Uttarakhand are among the closest, about 260 to 270 km away.

faqs.q: Which hill station near Delhi is best for a weekend?
faqs.a: Lansdowne, Kasauli and Mussoorie are the easiest two-day trips.

faqs.q: Can I see snow near Delhi?
faqs.a: In mid-winter, Mussoorie, Dhanaulti, Nainital, Chail and Kufri near Shimla sometimes get snow, but it is not guaranteed.

faqs.q: Is it better to drive or take the train?
faqs.a: Trains to Kalka, Dehradun, Kathgodam or Kotdwar avoid the worst highway traffic; drive or take a taxi from there.

faqs.q: Which hill station near Delhi is least crowded?
faqs.a: Lansdowne, Chail, Mukteshwar and Kasauli are calmer than Shimla, Mussoorie and Nainital.
